description: Department of Forest Conservation - Order Declare the State lands of the Valaivaittikulam Reserved forest from 7th August 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance and the notification of its control under the Conservator General of Forests. This constitutes a regulatory action and legal notification under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter (Type 5). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function being performed rather than constituting a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio assignment that would trigger a government classification type.
